title: Vampire Vape Cool Red Lips 10ml E-Liquid
description: The Vampire Vape Cool Red Lips 10ml E-Liquid is a sugary sweet delight you don’t want to miss out on. This scrummy e-juice has been inspired by those classic red lip sweets we used to relish from the pick and mix counter, this utterly moreish candy blend delivers a sweet tasting cherry flavour with a dash of ice-cool menthol for a sweet and juicy candy rush. This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 3mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits. If you love this delicious Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. They have a multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour requirements. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverage , sweet bakery, confectionary and dessert flavours or even their classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours.
